reference: lib/collab/fsm.dart（Dart 参考实现，向量生成时点冻结）
encoding: 枚举/状态一律语义大写名；时间为毫秒时间戳；对象键与 participants 字典序，列表保构造序

rules.enum_names: BUNDLE 状态: DRAFT/PROPOSED/STALLED/CONFIRMED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED/ARCHIVED/ABANDONED_LOCALLY；STEP 状态: PENDING/READY/TIME_CLASH/ROLE_CLASH/OPTIONAL/PRUNED/RECHECK；表决: PENDING/ACCEPTED/PENDING_RECHECK/REJECTED；REJECT 理由: TIME_CONFLICT/ROLE_UNWILLING；偏好: PREFER/OK/NO；类型: DIRECTIVE/CONSENSUS；action = proto 枚举名（PROPOSE/ACCEPT/REJECT/PATCH_TIME/PATCH_STEP_TIME/REASSIGN/MAKE_OPTIONAL/BYPASS/PRUNE/REOPEN/CANCEL/REKEY/ADD_MEMBER/LEAVE/VOTE/ADD_SLOT/FORCE_FINALIZE/NUDGE/…，骨架中性事件族语义=仅推水位）
rules.canonical_order: steps/ballots/votes 对象键与 participants（集合语义）一律字典序输出；required_uids/candidate_slots/uids 数组保构造序（REASSIGN=存留者在前新成员在后；BYPASS/LEAVE=过滤保序）
rules.nullable: initiator_id/winning_slot/quorum/expires_at_ms/stalled_since_ms 显式 null；ballots[].reason 仅 REJECTED 时在位
rules.event_script: input.events 按序应用，元素二形：{signal:{action,sender,seq,server_at_ms?,step_id?,slot_id?,reject_reason?,preference?,uids?,skeleton?,initial_slots?,quorum?,expires_at_ms?}} 网络事件；{local:{fn: maybe_expire|maybe_abandon, now_ms}} 本地伪事件（纯函数时钟注入）。初始态恒为空态 bundle_id + proposal_type：DRAFT / max_seq_id=0 / base_revision=1 / key_version=1 / participants、steps 皆空
rules.seq_watermark: 守卫丢弃的事件同样推进 max_seq_id（水位推进在 reducer 之后无条件执行）；seqId ≤ max_seq_id 且状态非 DRAFT 的事件整体忽略（重复/倒退防御）
rules.step_derive: 步骤派生：optional/pruned 显式终态短路保留；任一 required 成员 REJECTED 即时 clash（TIME_CONFLICT→TIME_CLASH / ROLE_UNWILLING→ROLE_CLASH）；recheck 态 acceptCount≥need→READY 否则保持 RECHECK；其余 acceptCount≥need→READY 否则 PENDING；need = threshold≤0 ? 名单长度 : threshold；赞成票仅计 required 成员的 ACCEPTED（pendingRecheck 不计）
rules.bundle_derive: 包派生：终态（CANCELLED/EXPIRED/ARCHIVED/ABANDONED_LOCALLY）/DRAFT/无步骤时短路；任一强一致步骤（非 optional 非 pruned）clash→STALLED；强一致全 READY/RECHECK→CONFIRMED；否则 PROPOSED。stalled_since_ms 进入 STALLED 时刻=触发事件 server_at_ms（已 STALLED 保持原值，离开 STALLED 置 null；ABANDONED_LOCALLY 保留原值）
rules.mutations: PROPOSE：threshold≤0 回落名单长度、全表决 PENDING；PATCH_TIME/REASSIGN/MAKE_OPTIONAL/BYPASS/PRUNE/REOPEN 使 base_revision+1，PATCH_STEP_TIME/LEAVE/REKEY/ADD_MEMBER 不动；REASSIGN 新名单=存留（非 rejected）+新 uids、全员 PENDING；BYPASS/LEAVE 门限收缩 min(原门限, 剩余名单长度)，LEAVE 空名单步骤转 optional（revision 不 +1）；REOPEN 显式落 STALLED（步骤回 PENDING 无 clash，纯派生会得 PROPOSED）；Directive PATCH_STEP_TIME 仅 CONFIRMED 态生效（步骤转 recheck，包经派生保持 CONFIRMED）；Consensus PATCH_STEP_TIME=发起人退回重议（CONFIRMED→PROPOSED、旧票清空、候选保留，slotId 在场时须=winning_slot）
rules.constants: kMaxCandidateSlots=8（ADD_SLOT 满额静默丢弃）；kStalledDeadlockTtl=48h（maybeAbandon：STALLED 且 now−stalled_since≥48h → ABANDONED_LOCALLY，发起人新信令到达即再激活回 STALLED）；提案流局 maybeExpire：仅 CONSENSUS+PROPOSED 且 now≥expires_at_ms→EXPIRED（expires_at_ms 来自 PROPOSE 载荷）
